critical_code_review_comments: Refactor LGTM. server.py becomes a thin entry mounting 5 routers (auth/inquiries/projects/files/client) — all 48 pre-existing endpoint tests still pass with no contract change. Nice clean separation.

client.py delete_document: only soft-deletes blob if file_url contains '/api/files/'. External URLs (like the sample.pdf seeded) are left untouched — correct behavior, but consider logging a warning when the file_url doesn't match the local /api/files/ pattern so admin users know external blobs aren't being touched.

client.py list_documents query construction has been simplified vs iter4 review comment — good. The `query['cp_id'] = cp_id` (admin path) and `{'$in': allowed}` (client path) are now clearly separate branches.

models.py CommentIn has min_length=1 but post-strip the body could be all whitespace and still pass validation (since validator only checks pre-strip). Currently the router calls .strip() on insert, which means a body of all spaces will store empty string. Suggest adding a Pydantic field_validator that rejects whitespace-only after strip.

seed.py seed_data inserts welcome comment only if comments collection is completely empty (count==0). If admin manually deletes the seeded welcome on a fresh DB, no re-seed occurs — but this is intentional and matches the documents seeding pattern. OK.
CommentsThread.jsx: deletes use window.confirm() which is fine but inconsistent with the rest of the UI which uses toast/sonner. Consider a confirm-dialog component for visual consistency.
SEO.jsx hard-codes DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE from emergentagent CDN — fine for now, but consider moving to env or a constants file so it can be swapped per environment without a code change.

CommentsThread auto-load runs on cp_id change; consider polling or websocket for real-time updates between admin and client (currently both need to refresh / re-toggle to see new messages from the other party).
